chartPattern.confirm: a close below the ~$66.35 support line
chartPattern.invalidate: a close back above the ~$68.70 resistance
chartPattern.explanation: Price formed a flat support around $66.35 from late May to early June, with a series of lower highs from $69.72 (May 26) down to $66.98 (June 4). The pattern confirmed with a sharp breakdown below support on June 5.
chartPattern.signal: A confirmed Descending Triangle suggests that the sellers have overcome buyers at a key support level, indicating a potential continuation of the downtrend with a measured move target around $59.00.
